ciara: Heads up — running a lightweight orphan-admin sweep for a few svc principals that bubbled up in the new telemetry rule. Posting the short list and a proposed canary plan.

ciara: ```
PRINCIPALS_FOUND:
- svc-archive-worker (admin) last_seen=2025-08-12 owner=<none>
- svc-experiments-runner (admin) last_seen=2024-12-20 owner=<none>
- svc-external-sync (admin) last_seen=2025-03-30 owner=<none>
```

todd: thanks. can you attach the most recent KMS and auth correlation for svc-external-sync before we do anything? that one often has cross-project grants.

mika: quick paste for svc-external-sync from the audit export: 

mika: ```
2025-03-30T22:11Z auth.token_issued principal=svc-external-sync
2025-03-30T22:11Z iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-external-sync key=projects/partnerX/kms/keys/shared-token
2024-11-01T08:00Z iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-external-sync key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/legacy-rotor
(no interactive sessions)
```

ciara: that's the cross-project grant I was worried about. infra: can you confirm whether partnerX still expects traffic or has an active integration? pinging @infra.

infra: checking partnerX status now. partner contact shows last handshake 2025-02; opened ticket P-9001 to confirm. will flag SEC-5043.

todd: if partnerX responds "active", then we need a joint change window: disable local admin role will break their decrypt path. options: rotate partner key with coordinated window, or add a minimal scoped service account that only has the required KMS ACLs.

ciara: proposal for low-risk canary playbook (short):
1) Tag principals with `recert:pending` and post to SEC-5043.
2) Create `staging-disabled` tag and run smoke tests for 24h in staging.
3) If no alerts, in prod run a 48h canary: apply IAM deny binding for admin role but keep KMS grants untouched for 24h.
4) If no impact, rotate any impacted keys and remove admin role. Provide emergency re-grant token TTL=30m via ops-runbook.

mika: small tweak: step 3 should explicitly include `monitoring:quiet=true` suppression for noisy alerts so SRE doesn't get paged for expected failures. we'll still track metrics in the dashboard.

sec-ops-bot: POLICY: auto-add flagged principals to "admin-orphan-watchlist". Notification sent to SEC-5043.

infra: got confirmation from partnerX: "integration still active, please coordinate changes". recommending we schedule a joint maintenance window.

ciara: ok — moving svc-external-sync to joint-window path. For svc-archive-worker and svc-experiments-runner we can proceed with the standard owner outreach -> 5bd wait -> staging canary.

todd: action items:
- infra: post partner coordination plan in P-9001 and SEC-5043 (ETA 24h) @infra
- mika: draft owner-outreach messages for the two orphans (send within EOD) @mika
- ciara: create SEC-5043 entries and attach KMS/export artifacts @ciara
- sec-ops-bot: schedule post-prune audit 7d after remediation @sec-ops-bot

mika: drafting outreach now. sample message: 

mika: ```
Hi — during continuous least-priv checks we found the principal `svc-archive-worker` with admin privileges but no owner on record. Please respond here or open a follow-up in SEC-5043 within 5 business days if this principal should be retained; otherwise we'll follow our staged disable + rotate runbook.
```

ciara: perfect. i've opened SEC-5043 and attached the `rbac-export` and `kms-grants.csv`. Ticket SEC-5043 created: "orphan-admins: initial triage & canary".

sec-ops-bot: Audit-sweep completed: 3 flagged principals. Full export uploaded to SEC-5043/artifacts/4598765432/export.json (sensitive).

infra: scheduled a short sync with partnerX for 2025-12-03T16:00Z; added change window placeholder.

todd: one last note: let's ensure key rotation steps include a staged re-encryption plan for any secrets that partnerX may depend on. I'll add that checklist to SEC-5043.

ciara: thanks all — closing loop here, will post updates as outreach replies come in. :mag:
